tiktok.caption:
why I can't send one email with ADHD (task paralysis, a timeline) 🫠

I avoided ONE email from 6pm to 11pm. cleaned the desk, deep cleaned the fridge. it was never laziness, my brain just couldn't find step 1. what finally worked: make step 1 tiny, like "type just the greeting". 4 minutes later it was sent.

what's YOUR one email? 👇
save this for the next email you're avoiding 📌

the app on the last slide is FOCO, link in bio 💜

instagram.caption:
Why one email can take all evening with ADHD (task paralysis, explained) 🫠

I avoided ONE email from 6pm to 11pm. It wasn't laziness. My brain couldn't find step 1.

1. 6pm: "I'll send it after dinner"
2. 8:15pm: opened it, closed it, cleaned my desk
3. 9:40pm: deep cleaned the fridge
4. 10:50pm: made step 1 tiny: type just the greeting

11:04pm: sent. 4 minutes, start to finish.

📌 Save this for the next email you're avoiding, and send it to someone who gets it.
💜 The app that finds my step 1 is FOCO, link in bio.
